title: Probabilistic Modeling of Inter- and Intra-observer Variability in Medical Image Segmentation (Pionono)
mechanism: Each rater gets a learned Gaussian in latent space. A sample is fused with image features to give that rater's segmentation, trained end to end by variational inference, so it models both inter-rater style and intra-rater variability.
adaptation: Rater = source (5 Gaussians); the latent variance captures within-source jitter. Small head on top of the house decoder; use the rater mean at test.
min_experiment: Arm = house PF + Pionono head (5 seeds) versus house PF and versus the FiLM arm. Metric: crack IoU clean-49. Kill if < +0.012 or not better than the FiLM arm.
evidence: R: prostate cancer histopathology with multiple pathologists; beats STAPLE, Probabilistic U-Net and confusion-matrix models.
